model_annotation: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of participants who rated each criterion on a scale from 0 to 6, with the criteria listed along the vertical axis and the number of participants along the horizontal axis. The vertical axis, labeled “Criterion,” lists six categories in descending order of their corresponding bar lengths: “Relevant FCs” (6 participants), “FC Summary” (5 participants), “Relevance Explanation” (3 participants), “Clarity and Simplicity” (3 participants), “Overall Summary” (2 participants), “Filters” (1 participant), and “Veracity Explanation” (1 participant). The horizontal axis, labeled “Number of Participants,” is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at intervals of 2. Each bar is color-coded: “Relevant FCs” is dark purple, “FC Summary” is dark blue, “Relevance Explanation” and “Clarity and Simplicity” are teal, “Overall Summary” is green, and “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” are light green. The bars are not sorted by value but are presented in a fixed order from top to bottom as labeled. There are no visual emphasis or annotations beyond the bar lengths and their corresponding numerical labels at the end of each bar.
